themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies amid border crises
themes.blurb: Multiple right-wing and far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies in response to recent border crises. In Spain, Vox has filed complaints over sexual assaults linked to migrant influxes in Ceuta, while Italy's Fratelli d'Italia and Lega criticize EU migration pacts. The U.S. under Trump has expanded deportations to third countries, including new agreements with African nations.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Filed complaints over sexual assaults in Ceuta following migrant influx, demanding joint investigations and stricter border controls.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Criticized EU migration pacts and resumed migrant returns from Sweden, Finland, and Germany under Dublin rules.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Expanded third-country deportations, including new agreements with African nations like Liberia and Guatemala.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticized government's handling of migrant children in Ceuta and proposed stricter welfare policies for foreign nationals.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposed ending free interpreter rights after three years and replacing them with AI solutions.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticized Macron's migration policies and proposed stricter controls, including potential referendums on immigration.

themes.title: Far-right parties gain ground in regional and national elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant electoral gains across Europe, with the AfD leading polls in Germany's Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern. In Sweden, the Sverigedemokraterna continue to influence government policies, while Reform UK has won historic council by-elections in the UK. These gains reflect broader voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and growing support for nationalist platforms.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leading polls in Saxony-Anhalt (42%) and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (36%), with potential to govern alone.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to influence government policies, with Jimmie Åkesson aiming for PM role by 2030.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Won historic council by-elections (42.5% of vote) and gained seats in local governments.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Leading 2027 presidential polls despite Marine Le Pen's past conviction, with strong electoral momentum.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Gained significant support in 2025 elections, particularly among young men, despite internal controversies.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, the U.S., and Poland are implementing or proposing significant cuts to social programs as part of broader fiscal consolidation efforts. Argentina's Milei has slashed sports funding and proposed pension reforms, while Trump's administration has targeted Medicaid and education programs. In Poland, PiS has proposed tax changes that critics argue will disproportionately affect middle-class families and small businesses.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Cut sports funding by 90%, leading to Olympic athlete protests, and proposed pension reforms.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposed Medicaid cuts, reduced education funding, and targeted teen pregnancy prevention programs.

countries.note: Proposed tax changes that critics argue will harm middle-class families and small businesses.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposed abolishing state pension triple guarantee and cutting benefits for foreign nationals.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposed tax cuts that critics argue will disproportionately benefit higher-income groups.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders face internal party divisions and leadership challenges
themes.blurb: Several right-wing parties are experiencing significant internal divisions and leadership challenges. Italy's Lega faces a rebellion from northern governors demanding Salvini's removal, while Argentina's La Libertad Avanza struggles with tensions between Milei and provincial leaders. In Hungary, Fidesz is undergoing a leadership transition following electoral defeat, with key figures like János Lázár resigning.

countries.note: Northern governors demand Salvini's removal, with anonymous banners at Pontida calling for 'renewal or revolt'.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Tensions between Milei and provincial leaders over economic policies and electoral strategies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Leadership transition following electoral defeat, with key figures like János Lázár resigning.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Internal divisions over Nigel Farage's leadership and party direction, with councillors leaving.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights and gender policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple countries are intensifying their focus on restricting LGBTQ+ rights and challenging gender policies. Argentina's Milei has blamed feminists and abortion rights advocates for economic problems, while Poland's PiS continues to push anti-LGBTQ+ legislation. In the U.S., Trump's administration has targeted gender-affirming healthcare, and Reform UK has proposed policies that critics argue will harm LGBTQ+ communities.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Blamed feminists and abortion rights advocates for economic problems, linking low birth rates to abortion laws.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Continues to push anti-LGBTQ+ legislation and criticize gender policies, with ongoing debates over 'lex szarlatan'.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Targeted gender-affirming healthcare, with HHS report alleging fraud in transgender care programs.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposed policies that critics argue will harm LGBTQ+ communities, including education reforms.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Criticized gender policies and supported traditional family values in political messaging.
